verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents its own REST API and CLI. The REST API automates retrieval and management of my.anydesk account data, covering clients, session history, closing sessions, comments, aliases and listing address books. The CLI handles installation, licensing, passwords, connections and removal. However, the portal's other functions (managing users, roles and permissions, custom clients, billing/subscription, and address book editing) appear nowhere in the API docs, so UI parity is not shown. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of user/role/permission management, billing and subscription settings, address book editing, and custom client configuration; a published API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404); independent corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The **AnyDesk REST API** lets you automate the retrieval and management of account data from the [my.anydesk I](http://my.anydesk.com/login) management console.
Retrieve Session History for a selected time range ... Close an active session
Add or update session comments ... Change a client Alias; Remove a client Alias
The AnyDesk Command-Line Interface (CLI) allows advanced users and IT administrators to automate installation, configuration, connection, and removal tasks.
